response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, entrepreneurial initiative with GISCollective, and demonstrated fluency in AI-agent tooling and cloud infrastructure, but lacks explicit AI/ML product ownership, advanced degrees in AI, and direct cloud platform strategy leadership — key for a director-level AI strategy role.
strengths: Proven entrepreneurial spirit with open-source AI-adjacent platform (GISCollective)
Hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks at re:cinq
Broad technical fluency across cloud, DevOps, and multiple languages including DLang and TypeScript
concerns: No demonstrated AI/ML product development or research output beyond tooling
Lacks advanced degree in AI or related field (only BS in CS)
Limited evidence of strategic cloud product roadmap leadership or customer advisory experience
